primary_estimand: Effect of skeletal-muscle-specific DJ-1 (Park7) knockout (MDKO vs Flox) on GAS gene expression under immobilization (tail suspension / disuse atrophy). Not an exercise effect.
constant_conditions: all sequenced animals were immobilized (S2.16.p1, S3.6.p1, FIG5)
sample_inclusion: GAS from immobilized MDKO (n=4) and Flox (n=3) mice (FIG5 n=3-4)
planned_contrasts: MDKO vs Flox, both immobilized (S3.6.p1; paper: 1113 DEGs, 763 down / 350 up)
exercise_in_paper: Treadmill/rotarod/grip/ladder tests are phenotyping endpoints only (S2.11.p1, S3.2.p1); no exercised animals were sequenced.

paper_threshold.source_locator: GEO data_processing (DESeq2, adjusted P < 0.05 and |FC| > 1.5); paper text gives no rule
